intro.h2: A Greater Madison design-build firm that starts by listening
paragraphs: Degnan Design-Build-Remodel has offered kitchen remodeling in Madison, WI and the towns around it since Bob Degnan founded the company in 1981. His son Abe grew up on job sites as a helper and carpenter, then earned an architecture degree and brought a design-first approach to the family business.

Today the same team designs, prices and builds each project. A designer draws several concepts, then 3D drawings, before anyone swings a hammer. A lead carpenter runs the site once work starts. In GuildQuality surveys, 95% of clients say they would recommend the firm and 98% call the team professional and organized.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Madison, WI, and the rest of the house

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: From open-concept kitchens for entertaining to efficient updates and kitchen additions. Recent projects include a kitchen with laundry in Lodi, a dual-island kitchen in DeForest and a 1970s kitchen reworked for a retired couple. Most kitchen builds take about 2 to 3 months.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel in DeForest, WI with wood cabinets, white subway tile, quartz counters and a corner sink under three windows

items.name: Master Suite and Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary suites, steam showers, soaking tubs, powder rooms and tub-to-shower conversions. The team has remodeled baths in Wexford Village, Maple Bluff, Waunakee and East Madison. Plan on about 1.5 to 2.5 months of construction for a bathroom.

image.alt: Ensuite bathroom remodel in DeForest, WI with dual wood vanities, backlit mirrors and a green linen tower

items.name: Aging-in-Place Remodeling
items.blurb: Abe Degnan holds the CAPS designation for aging-in-place work. The portfolio shows curbless showers, grab bars and open kitchens planned for later years, including an affordable aging-in-place bath in Brooklyn, WI and a contemporary one in Maple Bluff.

image.alt: Aging-in-place bathroom remodel in Maple Bluff, WI with a brass grab bar, white cabinetry and open display shelving

items.name: Finished Basements
items.blurb: Degnan calls it a finished lower level, because it should look and feel like the rest of the house. Past projects include media rooms, a wet bar, an exercise room and a lower-level living room in Oregon, WI. Basement builds usually run about 2 to 3 months.

image.alt: Finished lower-level living room in Oregon, WI with blue board-and-batten wainscoting, a wood staircase and framed family photos

items.name: Condominium Remodeling
items.blurb: Condo work means HOA approval, building rules and shared walls. Degnan has remodeled units in Metropolitan Place, Weston Place, Hawks Reserve, Nolen Shores and The Marina Condominiums, plus a transitional condo kitchen and mudroom in Middleton.

image.alt: Condominium kitchen remodel in Middleton, WI with cherry cabinets, stainless appliances and a round dining table

why_choose_us.h2: What sets the Degnan team apart

items.title: Two generations, one family name
items.text: Bob Degnan started the company in 1981. His son Abe now leads it as president and Director of Design, and Zach Degnan works on the design team.

items.title: Scores you can check
items.text: Independent GuildQuality surveys show 95% of clients likely to recommend Degnan, 96% satisfied with communication and 98% who felt the team was professional and organized.

items.title: Award-winning work
items.text: Wins include Wisconsin Builders Association Builder of the Year in 2024 and NARI Madison Contractor of the Year for a residential kitchen under $100K in 2023.

items.title: They come back after the job
items.text: You get lien paperwork, product manuals and warranties at the end. The team also checks in at 6 months and 1 year to catch any warranty work.

about.h2: Meet Abe Degnan, president and Director of Design
about.text: Abe Degnan learned the trade as a helper and carpenter in his father's company. After earning an architecture degree from UW-Milwaukee, he brought a design-first approach to the firm Bob Degnan founded in 1981. Abe now leads the team as president and Director of Design, mentors the designers and runs day-to-day operations. He holds the CGR, CGB and CAPS designations. His stated goal for every job is that it finishes on time, on budget and more beautiful than you imagined. Abe is also a proud father of six.

image.alt: Abe Degnan, president of Degnan Design-Build-Remodel

process.h2: Nine steps, three phases: how a Degnan project runs

steps.title: A first conversation
steps.text: A free call about your project, your goals and a ballpark budget. Photos of your space help the team give you a useful range.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: After a consultation and budgeting meeting, a designer measures, sketches several concepts and develops the best one into 3D drawings.

steps.title: Selections and estimating
steps.text: Your designer goes with you to showrooms. Trade partners walk your home so the estimate is accurate and change orders stay rare.

steps.title: Contract and preparation
steps.text: You sign a contract with agreed start and finish dates. Degnan pulls permits, places orders and hands the job to your lead carpenter.

steps.title: Build and follow-through
steps.text: The crew protects your home and controls dust. After a final walk-through, the team checks in at 6 months and 1 year.

service_area.h2: Remodeling across Madison and Dane County
service_area.text: Degnan works from its office on Lake Road in Windsor and builds throughout Greater Madison. That includes Madison neighborhoods such as Middleton Hills, Nakoma, Maple Bluff, Shorewood Hills and the University area, plus the Dane County towns below and the Lake Wisconsin area. The team also has experience in luxury and high-rise condominiums such as Metropolitan Place and Weston Place.

faq.h2: Questions Madison-area homeowners ask Degnan

items.q: Is a ballpark estimate free?
items.a: Yes. Ballpark budget talks are free and happen by phone, video chat or at the Windsor office. You share your wish list, photos and budget goals. If you want a full design, written budget and scope of work, that starts with a paid design retainer.

items.q: How many months should we plan for a Degnan kitchen or bath?
items.a: Design, selections and estimating usually take a few months. After that, Degnan's typical build times are 2 to 3 months for a kitchen, 1.5 to 2.5 months for a bathroom and 2 to 3 months for a finished basement. The firm says 90% of its projects fall in these ranges.

items.q: Can we live at home during the remodel?
items.a: Most Degnan clients do. Before work begins, the crew protects your home and sets up dust control. Payments follow the progress of the work, and you meet with your lead carpenter, designer and production manager from time to time so you always know what is happening next.

items.q: Are the photos on the website really Degnan projects?
items.a: Yes. Degnan states that it does not use stock photos and that every project shown is its own work. Its reviews are real too: client surveys are published on GuildQuality, and more project and in-progress photos are posted on its Facebook and Houzz pages.

items.q: Can you help before we buy a house?
items.a: Yes. Send the MLS listing and photos, and the team will spend about half an hour with you by phone or video at no charge to talk through whether the home can be remodeled the way you want. Realtors can use the same service for clients.

final_cta.h2: Start with a free ballpark budget call
final_cta.text: Tell the Degnan team about your kitchen or bath, and get a realistic range before you commit to design.

hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Maitland, Planned and Built by One Team

intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Maitland from a showroom inside city limits
paragraphs: KBF Design Gallery has done kitchen remodeling in Maitland and across Central Florida since 2003. Since 2020 its design showroom has stood at 1295 South Orlando Avenue, a short drive from Dommerich Estates, Lake Sybelia and Kaywood. Cabinetry, stone, tile, fixtures and lighting are all on display there, so selections take days instead of months.

Much of Maitland was built mid-century around its lakes, and those floor plans often need a wall to come out. KBF plans that structural work in-house, with an engineer's design where required, and tells you what the wall needs before demolition. One owner's 1986 Dommerich Estates kitchen lost its peninsula and gained a grand island without adding a square foot.

services.h2: Kitchens, baths and whole homes from the KBF studio

items.name: Custom Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full-gut kitchens with custom or semi-custom cabinet lines built for Florida humidity, natural stone or quartz, and structural openings when the plan calls for one. You see the exact door style, slab and hardware in the Maitland showroom before anything is ordered.

image.alt: Maitland kitchen remodel with a dark wood island, wishbone counter stools, black dome pendants, white cabinets and a blue-patterned tile inset behind the range

items.name: Custom Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary suites, wet rooms and guest baths. The team scopes the whole room, including what demolition may reveal and where the water lines run, so the written estimate is fixed to drawings and selections you have already approved.

image.alt: Baldwin Park primary bathroom with a marble wet room, freestanding tub, arched shower opening, brass sconces and a stained wood double vanity

items.name: Whole-Home Remodeling and Additions
items.blurb: For houses that have not been touched in decades. Most clients live at home during the work, so KBF zones it in phases, seals dust at each zone and sets up a temporary kitchen. Additions tie new square footage into the original house.

image.alt: Maitland whole-home renovation kitchen with a white quartz peninsula, black counter stools, stainless chimney hood and brass-and-glass shelves on herringbone tile

items.name: Studio KBF Same-Footprint Remodels
items.blurb: Keeping your layout? Studio KBF is a streamlined, designer-led remove-and-replace for a kitchen, a primary bath or every room, with plumbing and electrical staying largely in place. It uses the same designers, project managers and 5-year warranty with a curated palette.

image.alt: Winter Park townhome kitchen with rift-cut oak slab cabinets, a marble waterfall island, woven counter stools and glass doors to a pool courtyard

items.name: Outdoor Living
items.blurb: Summer kitchens, covered lanais, fireplace lounges, pergolas and pool surrounds. KBF designs, engineers, permits and builds them as one team from the Maitland studio, so the designer and the crew never work from different assumptions.

image.alt: Central Florida backyard with a covered lanai, built-in outdoor kitchen, travertine pool deck and a round fire feature by the pool

why_choose_us.h2: Why Maitland homeowners call KBF

items.title: Awards decided by judges and by neighbors
items.text: First place for general contractor at the 2026 Orlando Magazine Home Design Awards, the fifth year running, plus two Gold and one Silver in the Orlando Sentinel's 2026 public-vote Central Florida Favorites.

items.title: Hometown track record
items.text: More than 30 Maitland projects over two decades, part of 1,000+ completed across Central Florida, drawn from the firm's own client records.

items.title: Prices tied to paper
items.text: Allowances and selections are shown in writing at trade pricing passed through, and any change to a specified material is documented and approved by you before it happens.

items.title: Warranty and financing
items.text: Every project carries a 5-year craftsmanship warranty in writing. KBF also offers financing, subject to credit approval, so ask your design team member for details.

about.h2: Owned and led by Ashley Sheaffer and Adam Vellequette
about.text: KBF Design Gallery was founded in 2003 and has stayed family-owned ever since. Today principals Ashley Sheaffer and Adam Vellequette own the firm, and Google lists it as women-owned. Ashley was named to Pro Remodeler's 40 Under 40 in 2025. The team pairs award-winning designers with experienced builders and a dedicated project manager on each job. Clients name them in reviews: Laura, Ashley and Larry come up for being responsive, and one homeowner said she knew she was in good hands the moment she met Laura. The firm is a member of the Maitland Area Chamber of Commerce.

steps.title: Complimentary consultation
steps.text: The conversation starts with your goals, not a sales pitch: what prompts the remodel, what you like and dislike now, and photos that inspire you.

steps.title: Design before demolition
steps.text: Designers answer the layout, structure and finish questions in order. One Windermere primary bath took 189 documented decisions before the first hammer swung.

steps.title: Showroom selections and written scope
steps.text: You choose cabinets, stone, tile and lighting in the Maitland showroom. The estimate is fixed to those drawings and selections.

steps.title: Permits and construction
steps.text: KBF pulls permits under license CGC 1529022 with the City of Maitland or Orange County. A dedicated project manager keeps a weekly rhythm and a client portal.

steps.title: Completion and warranty
steps.text: Your finished room is backed by the 5-year craftsmanship warranty, and a warranty claim form stays available on the KBF site.

service_area.h2: Maitland first, then the whole Orlando ring
service_area.text: Maitland is the home address, and the team knows its permit split: City of Maitland inside the limits, Orange County in the pockets around them. KBF also remodels across Winter Park, Baldwin Park, Windermere, Dr. Phillips, Lake Mary, Longwood, Oviedo, Winter Springs, Winter Garden, Apopka and Celebration, with projects out to New Smyrna Beach and Ponce Inlet on the coast.

faq.h2: Maitland remodeling questions, answered

items.q: Can you take out a load-bearing wall in my Maitland home?
items.a: Yes. Structural work is part of KBF's everyday scope. Changes are confirmed by field verification and, where required, a licensed structural engineer's design, using engineered beams and properly sized posts. You learn what the wall needs before demolition, and the work is permitted and inspected.

items.q: Who handles permits in Maitland?
items.a: KBF does. Addresses inside the city limits permit through the City of Maitland building division, and the surrounding pockets go through Orange County. The team checks which applies to your address, pulls permits under Florida license CGC 1529022 and schedules inspections into the build.

items.q: Can we live at home during a big remodel?
items.a: Most whole-home clients do. The work is zoned in phases with dust containment at each zone boundary, a working temporary kitchen while yours is down, and a weekly update so you know what happens next. A client portal tracks schedule, selections and progress between visits.

items.q: What if I want to keep my current layout?
items.a: Studio KBF handles same-footprint remodels of any size, from one kitchen to every room, as long as walls and major plumbing stay put. If your project turns out to need engineering, the team tells you at the consultation and moves it to a full KBF Signature remodel.

items.q: When can I visit the showroom?
items.a: The showroom at 1295 South Orlando Avenue in Maitland is open Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., and Saturday, 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Cabinetry, stone, tile and lighting are all there. Call (407) 337-8609 to set up a complimentary design consultation.

final_cta.h2: Bring your Maitland kitchen to the South Orlando Avenue showroom

hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling Bellevue, WA: Planned Before Demolition
hero.subheadline: Nip Tuck Remodeling designs and builds kitchens, baths and whole homes across Seattle's Eastside. Every detail and every trade price is settled before construction, so projects finish within about 2% of the estimate.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Bellevue: lakeview kitchen with a navy island, white counters, blue glass tile backsplash and oak floors

intro.h2: A Bellevue kitchen remodeling firm that plans first and builds second
paragraphs: Nip Tuck Remodeling has handled kitchen remodeling Bellevue-wide and across Seattle's Eastside since 2010. Founder April Bettinger built a woman-owned design-build firm where designers, project managers and trade partners work as one team. Kitchens are the firm's stated specialty, and the same team handles primary baths and whole-home remodels.

The difference shows up before demolition. Floor plans, finishes, structural needs and real pricing from every trade are locked in first. That is why Nip Tuck projects land within about 2% of the original estimate, against an industry norm of 10 to 20%. One Google reviewer called the finished kitchen "the center place of our home" a year later.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling Bellevue families ask for, plus baths and whole homes

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Custom cabinetry, a well-placed island, layered task and undercabinet lighting, and surfaces such as quartzite, porcelain and hardwood. Appliance and finish choices are made early, during design, so the schedule and budget hold once the crew starts work in your kitchen.

image.alt: Bridle Trails kitchen remodel with a stainless hood, pot filler, gray tile wall and white shaker cabinets

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary and guest baths planned around daily routines, with custom storage, lighting placed for mirrors and mood, and comfort features like zero-threshold showers, heated floors and ergonomic vanity heights. Primary bathrooms often take 8 to 10 weeks from the start of construction.

image.alt: Kirkland bathroom remodel with a wood double vanity, soaking tub, frameless glass shower and open shelving

items.name: Whole-Home Remodels
items.blurb: Multi-room remodels that rework flow, light and storage across a main floor or an entire house. The Medina Cottage on the Course project added a new dining area and earned a 2026 REX Award, and the firm's work has appeared on the Remodeled Homes Tour.

image.alt: Medina whole-home remodel with a dining addition, long farmhouse table, navy cabinetry and an open kitchen beyond

items.name: One-Room Remodels
items.blurb: A streamlined version of the full Nip Tuck process for a single space: laundry rooms, guest baths, fireplaces and living rooms. Materials and lighting are chosen to match future phases, so one room can be the first step toward a larger plan.

image.alt: Sammamish laundry room remodel with stacked washer and dryer, white cabinets and patterned cement tile floor

items.name: Nip Tuck Interiors
items.blurb: Once construction wraps, the interior design team led by Design Director Allison can finish the rooms with full-service furnishings, custom window treatments and styling. It keeps the look of a new kitchen or main floor consistent all the way to the furniture.

image.alt: Living room at The Farm in Woodinville with a white marble fireplace surround and styled seating

why_choose_us.h2: What Eastside homeowners get from Nip Tuck

items.title: Costs that stay close to the plan
items.text: Nip Tuck reports an average cost variance of about 2% from the original estimate. The firm credits thorough pre-construction planning, not a padded contingency, for that number.

items.title: You always know where things stand
items.text: Each client gets a dedicated point of contact, weekly check-ins and a live project calendar. A Google reviewer noted the client portal "had budget/payment info, a live work schedule, pictures, communication, etc."

items.title: More than 50 awards
items.text: Recent honors include 2nd place at the 2026 REX Awards, a spot on Qualified Remodeler's 2026 Top 500, and a 1st place NKBA Design Award for Design Director Allison Scott.

items.title: A limited number of projects at once
items.text: The firm grows its team before it adds to its workload and turns down jobs it cannot fully deliver. Third-party surveys check in with clients at contract signing and again at completion.

about.h2: Founded by April Bettinger in 2010
about.text: April Bettinger started Nip Tuck Remodeling in 2010 with a focus on craftsmanship, professionalism and a close-knit team. Today it is a 100% woman-owned design-build firm that has served hundreds of Eastside families. April wrote Happiness Guaranteed: A Successful Remodel Doesn't Happen by Accident, which reached #1 in Amazon's kitchen and bathroom remodeling categories and lays out the planning-first approach her clients experience. Clients mention her by name. One wrote that April and her team were "exceptionally detailed in ways I never could have imagined a contractor would be."

image.alt: April Bettinger, founder and owner of Nip Tuck Remodeling in Bellevue, WA

process.h2: From a 15-minute call to the final walkthrough

steps.title: Fit conversation
steps.text: A 15-minute call about what you are imagining, followed by an honest answer on whether Nip Tuck is the right team for your project.

steps.title: Design and selections
steps.text: Designers study how you use the space, then finalize the floor plan and every finish before any pricing is treated as final.

steps.title: Real pricing from every trade
steps.text: Structural needs are confirmed and each trade partner prices the actual plan, so no open questions remain when construction begins.

steps.title: Build with weekly check-ins
steps.text: Your point of contact keeps a live project calendar and checks in every week, telling you what is happening before you have to ask.

steps.title: Walkthrough and feedback
steps.text: The project ends with a walkthrough, and a third-party survey asks how the experience went so the Happiness Guaranteed promise can be measured.

Even through weather delays and unexpected problems she was professional and caring and her team were exactly the same. I never thought I would say this for any remodel but it was worth every penny. My home looks amazing.

service_area.h2: Nip Tuck neighborhoods on Seattle's Eastside
service_area.text: The office is on SE 36th Street in Bellevue, and the firm works across the Eastside. That ranges from Lakemont and Newport Hills homes in Bellevue to waterfront houses on Mercer Island, 1980s homes in Redmond, Beaver Lake and Sahalee family homes in Sammamish, and acreage properties in Woodinville. Kitchens in Kirkland, bathrooms in Bellevue and primary suites in Sammamish are all in the portfolio.

faq.h2: Questions to ask before your Eastside remodel

items.q: How long does a kitchen or bathroom remodel take?
items.a: According to Nip Tuck's own guidance, primary bathrooms often take 8 to 10 weeks, and a kitchen combined with a main-floor remodel may run around three months. Those figures cover construction. Design and selections happen first, because the firm will not start building until the plan is complete and approved.

items.q: How close will the final cost be to the estimate?
items.a: Nip Tuck reports that its projects finish within about 2% of the original estimated investment, compared with an industry norm of 10 to 20%. Before construction, floor plans are finalized, finishes are selected, structural requirements are confirmed and real pricing is collected from every trade partner on the job.

items.q: Will you take on just one room?
items.a: Yes. One-room remodels use a streamlined version of the Nip Tuck process for laundry rooms, primary and guest bathrooms, fireplaces and living rooms. A single primary bath or kitchen gets the same standard of care as a whole-home project. The investment scale is different, and choices are made to fit later phases.

items.q: When is Nip Tuck not the right fit?
items.a: The firm says so up front. It may not suit you if you are remodeling mainly to sell, plan to do part of the work yourself, have fixed the budget before design starts, or need to move fast. Its process favors thorough planning, so a short call usually settles the question.

items.q: What does Happiness Guaranteed mean?
items.a: It is Nip Tuck's promise that you should be happy with the whole experience, not only the finished room. In practice that means weekly check-ins, third-party surveys at contract signing and at completion, and a planning-first process. April Bettinger explains it in her book of the same name.

final_cta.h2: Start your Bellevue kitchen remodeling plan with a short call
final_cta.text: Call April's team at (425) 645-9625 or book a 15-minute discovery call to find out if Nip Tuck is the right fit for your home.

intro.h2: A Marine-run remodeler that shows its prices first
paragraphs: Semper Fi Custom Remodeling handles kitchen remodeling in Asheville, NC and across Western North Carolina from its office on US-70 in Black Mountain. The name is Latin for "Always Faithful," a motto owners Jay Cope and Chris Harrin brought home from the Marine Corps. On the job, it means keeping their word on price, schedule and craftsmanship.

The team is upfront with numbers. Its pricing page lists 2026 ranges from real projects, starting at $80k to $120k for a kitchen that keeps its layout. You get one point of contact and an online portal for schedules, selections and approvals. Reviewers keep coming back to the same point: they always knew what was happening.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Asheville, NC and the rest of the house

items.name: Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Projects run from new cabinets and stone counters to removing a load-bearing wall for an open floor plan. Designers help you choose finishes you love inside the budget you set. Posted 2026 ranges start at $80k for a same-layout update and reach $180k and up for a full gut.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with white shaker cabinets, marble-look slab backsplash, long island with black stools and oak floors

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Guest baths, hall baths and primary suites, including curbless showers and tub-to-shower conversions. A bathroom touches nearly every trade, so the team shows you where to save without losing the look. Half baths start at $25k; a primary suite with moved walls runs $90k to $150k and up.

image.alt: Primary bathroom remodel with freestanding soaking tub, brass faucet, green tile shower and a floor-to-ceiling window onto fall woods

items.name: Aging-in-Place Modifications (CAPS)
items.blurb: Certified Aging-in-Place Specialists plan curbless showers, wider doorways, grab bars, pull-out drawers and easy-reach controls so you can stay in the home you love. A Montreat project even added an elevator shaft. The firm's whole-home CAPS renovation took 1st place nationally at the NAHB Remodelers Awards.

image.alt: Curbless shower with fold-down teak seat, grab bar, handheld shower and linear drain in marble-look porcelain tile

items.name: Home Additions & ADUs
items.blurb: Primary suites, second stories, bump-outs, garage apartments and ADUs for families who would rather grow the house than move. Addition projects took first and second place nationally with the NAHB in 2024. Posted ranges start at $60k for a small bump-out with no plumbing.

image.alt: Bright sunroom addition with exposed wood beams, three windows, gray floor and a rocking chair by a brick wall

items.name: Whole Home Renovations
items.blurb: Every room on one plan and one schedule, from small mountain cabins to 7,000-square-foot homes. One Greenville, SC project paired an interior remodel with a home addition and a floating open-tread staircase. Multi-room remodels often cost less than pricing each room on its own.

image.alt: Whole-home remodel and addition in Greenville, SC with floating wood stair treads, cable railing and a guest bedroom off the living room

why_choose_us.h2: What sets this Black Mountain team apart

items.title: Prices before the sales call
items.text: The pricing page lists real 2026 ranges by room, such as $40k to $60k for a full bath that keeps its layout. You can set a budget before anyone visits.

items.title: One contact, one online portal
items.text: Each client gets a single point of contact and a portal that holds schedules, selections and approvals. Reviewers praise weekly on-site updates from their project manager.

items.title: Licensed in two states
items.text: NC License #78021 and SC License #CLG-125771, an A+ BBB rating, NC Accredited Master Builder and Accredited Remodeler designations, and Living Wage certification from Just Economics.

items.title: Final payment after the work
items.text: A tiered payment system means the final payment is not collected until the job is complete. The team also helps clients compare renovation loans and trusted loan partners.

about.h2: Meet Jay Cope and Chris Harrin
about.text: Jay Cope (CEO) and Chris Harrin (President) are childhood friends who went on to serve in the Marine Corps together. They built Semper Fi Custom Remodeling on the Corps values of honor, courage and commitment, and they handpick each member of the team. Jay was sworn in as 2024 President of the Builders Association of the Blue Ridge Mountains. The company now runs offices in Black Mountain, NC and Greenville, SC. Its work has earned NAHB national awards, a 2023 WNC Parade of Homes Gold Craftsmanship Award and six 2026 NCHBA STARS Awards.

process.h2: Five steps from first call to warranty

steps.title: Conversation and fit
steps.text: A first call about your goals, priorities, timeline and budget range, so both sides know early whether the project is a good match.

steps.title: On-site walkthrough
steps.text: The team meets you at home, checks existing conditions and flags anything that could change scope or cost before plans are drawn.

steps.title: Ballpark, design and estimate
steps.text: You get a ballpark investment range, then refine layout and selections with the in-house design team until the number fits your target.

steps.title: Proposal and portal
steps.text: You review the full proposal together. Once scheduled, every update, selection and approval lives in one online portal with a single point of contact.

steps.title: Build, walkthrough, warranty
steps.text: Crews keep your home clean during construction, finish with a final walkthrough and move you into the warranty phase, with support after completion.

service_area.h2: Towns we cover from Black Mountain and Greenville
service_area.text: Crews work out of two offices: 3038 US-70 in Black Mountain for Asheville and Western North Carolina, and 355 Woodruff Rd in Greenville for the Upstate. The site lists more than 40 towns across the two states, and its case studies cover homes in Black Mountain, Asheville and Fairview. If your town is not shown below, call the office and ask.

faq.h2: Questions Asheville homeowners ask before they call

items.q: What does a kitchen remodel cost in the Asheville area?
items.a: Semper Fi's posted 2026 ranges run from $80k to $120k for a kitchen that keeps its layout, $100k to $140k for new cabinets in the same footprint, $140k to $200k when plumbing, electrical or structural walls move, and $180k and up for a full gut. Final cost depends on selections, scope and site conditions.

items.q: How are payments handled?
items.a: Payments follow a tiered system, and the final payment is not collected until the job is complete. If you plan to finance part of the work, the team helps you compare options, including renovation loans and trusted loan partners. Ask about the payment schedule on your first call so it fits your plans.

items.q: Can you help us stay in our home as we get older?
items.a: Yes. The team includes Certified Aging-in-Place Specialists trained through the NAHB. Common changes are curbless or roll-in showers, grab bars, wider doorways and halls, lever handles, lower counters, stairlifts and home elevators. Plans follow universal design, so the house also works for younger family members and guests.

items.q: Do you rebuild storm-damaged homes?
items.a: Yes. Semper Fi has a restoration division for residential and commercial property damage in Western North Carolina. Several reviewers describe how the team helped them work through insurance claims after Hurricane Helene, then managed the subcontractors and schedule until their homes were put back together.

items.q: Who will be my main point of contact?
items.a: You get a single point of contact from proposal through completion. Schedules, updates, selections and approvals sit in a dedicated online portal, so you can check progress any time. The same team that walks your home at the start stays involved as ideas turn into plans and plans turn into a finished room.

final_cta.h2: Ready to talk through your kitchen?
final_cta.text: Call the Black Mountain office at (828) 279-6703, or send a few project details and the team will call you back to talk budget and scheduling.

intro.h2: Design-build remodeling in Madison, WI, the Sweeney Way
paragraphs: Sweeney Design Remodel has offered design-build remodeling in Madison, WI since 1954. One team handles the design, the budget and the construction of kitchens, baths, basements and additions, so the people who draw your plans also answer for how they get built.

The difference is timing. Before a contract is written, Sweeney brings its plumbers, electricians and HVAC partners through your home, so problems show up on paper instead of behind your walls. Most of those trade partners have worked with Sweeney for 25 years or more, and when you refer a friend, the same people show up at their house.

services.h2: Kitchens, baths, basements and additions for Dane County homes

items.name: Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Reworked layouts, opened walls, custom cabinetry, quartz or natural stone tops and layered lighting, plus the panel, plumbing and venting updates behind them. Sweeney kitchens won a NARI Contractor of the Year award in 2006 and a Chrysalis Award in 2005, both in the over-$100,000 class.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel in the Sauk Creek area of Madison, WI with a walnut island, white quartzite top, open wood shelves and globe pendants

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Primary baths that feel cramped often need a smarter layout more than more square feet. Sweeney reworks the flow, builds roomier walk-in showers or soaking-tub retreats, adds vanity storage and sometimes borrows space from a closet next door. Its baths earned NARI Contractor of the Year awards in 2004 and 2013.

image.alt: Primary bathroom in a Madison, WI whole-home remodel with a clawfoot tub, white subway tile and tall double-hung windows

items.name: Basement Remodels
items.blurb: Unfinished or dated lower levels become rec rooms, wet bars, studies, laundry and storage. Sweeney won NARI Contractor of the Year for a basement over $100,000 in 2017, and one Madison client said friends touring her finished basement could not believe it was the same house.

image.alt: Finished basement in Madison, WI with a wet bar, navy herringbone tile wall, brass pendant, wine rack and beverage fridge

items.name: Home Additions and Whole-Home Remodels
items.blurb: Additions and whole-house projects are where one accountable team matters most, because structure, permits, mechanicals and finishes all have to fit together. Sweeney took NARI Contractor of the Year for additions over $250,000 in 2005, 2006 and 2019, and for an entire house in 2017.

image.alt: Hallway in a historic Madison, WI whole-home remodel with additions, with hardwood floors, white millwork and a refinished staircase

items.name: Condo Kitchens and Baths
items.blurb: Condo work means tight galley or peninsula layouts and careful crews in shared buildings. Sweeney has remodeled complete Madison condos, and the president of the Marina Condo Owners Association wrote that the crew protected both his unit and the common areas while keeping residents informed.

image.alt: Madison, WI condo kitchen remodel with white shaker cabinets, glass-front uppers, a navy peninsula and blue upholstered stools

why_choose_us.h2: Why Dane County homeowners call Sweeney back

items.title: Trades in your home during design
items.text: Plumbers, electricians and HVAC partners walk your home with the designers before pricing is final. Most have worked with Sweeney for 25+ years and must be licensed, insured and on time.

items.title: Budgets built from real history
items.text: A Comparative Remodeling Analysis breaks your budget into line items using Sweeney's own past project costs. One client wrote that the price looked higher at first but already covered the unexpected details.

items.title: Certified people on the job
items.text: Tim Sweeney and Rich Deegan are NARI Certified Remodelers, Rich is also a Certified Remodeling Project Manager, and three more team members hold the Certified Lead Carpenter credential.

items.title: A warranty you can read
items.text: Every remodel carries a one-year workmanship warranty covering labor, materials and subcontractor work, and Sweeney transfers manufacturer warranties on products and equipment to you when the job is done.

about.h2: Tim Sweeney and the team behind the Sweeney name
about.text: Tim Sweeney, CR, is President and Project Developer of Sweeney Design Remodel, a Madison company that began in 1954 as a people-centered business. Linda Sweeney is Vice President and Design Consultant. NARI of Madison gave Tim its Image Award in 2006 and again in 2013. The team today includes project developers, an interior designer, a field production manager, an estimator, lead carpenters, carpenters, a painter and an apprentice. Each winner of the in-house Metronome Award passes it on to the colleague who best measures, manages and leads. The firm also coaches high school students at Madison trades career days.

image.alt: Tim Sweeney, CR, President of Sweeney Design Remodel in Madison, WI

process.h2: From a 30-minute call to a warrantied finish

steps.title: Phone call and home visit
steps.text: A 30-minute call covers your needs, budget and timeline. If it fits, a project developer visits to study your space, existing conditions and scope.

steps.title: Design agreement and budget analysis
steps.text: You sign a design agreement and receive a Comparative Remodeling Analysis, a realistic line-by-line budget based on Sweeney's historical project data.

steps.title: Design development and trade walk-through
steps.text: Designers measure, photograph and draw your plans and guide your selections. Then subcontractors and vendors walk your home to head off surprises.

steps.title: Pre-construction
steps.text: Estimators turn drawings and selections into a contract. Sweeney pulls permits, orders materials, builds the schedule and introduces your lead carpenter.

steps.title: Construction and warranty
steps.text: Your project coordinator and lead carpenter run the job with the trades, and the finished work is backed by the one-year workmanship warranty.

service_area.text: Sweeney works from its office at 1008 Fish Hatchery Rd in Madison and remodels homes across Dane County. The firm names the towns and neighborhoods below, from Maple Bluff and Shorewood Hills to Sun Prairie, Verona and Waunakee. Reviews on its site come from homeowners in Madison and Waunakee, and from the Marina Condo Owners Association. If your address is nearby but not listed, a short call will tell you whether it fits.

faq.h2: Questions Madison homeowners ask Sweeney

items.q: Do I need to move out during a kitchen remodel?
items.a: Usually not. Most families stay home, but expect noise, dust and short shutoffs of water, power or gas during demolition and rough-in. Some set up a temporary kitchen with a microwave and small appliances, while others book short-term housing. Your design-build team helps you decide based on scope, utility interruptions and your household schedule.

items.q: How does the first step work?
items.a: It starts with a 30-minute phone call about your needs, what is not working in your space, your budget and your hoped-for timeline. If that conversation lines up, Sweeney schedules a visit to your home to look at existing conditions and scope before any design agreement is signed.

items.q: What does the one-year warranty cover?
items.a: If materials or construction show defects under normal use in the first year after completion, Sweeney repairs or replaces them at no cost to you. The warranty covers labor, materials and workmanship by its subcontractors, and manufacturer warranties on materials and equipment are transferred to you as the manufacturer allows.

items.q: Why bring subcontractors in during design?
items.a: Plumbers, electricians and HVAC partners walk your home with the design team before the contract is priced. They flag issues and suggest options while changes still cost nothing but a redraw, which helps prevent surprises, delays and budget overruns later. Most of these partners have worked with Sweeney for more than 25 years.

items.q: Is Sweeney the right size for my project?
items.a: Sweeney handles kitchens, baths, basements, additions and whole homes, and it has also taken on smaller fixes such as railings, windows and repairs for past clients. One homeowner noted that when a project is too big for the team, Sweeney says so and recommends someone else. A phone consult at (608) 257-3034 settles it quickly.

final_cta.h2: Ready to talk straight about your remodel?
final_cta.text: Call (608) 257-3034 for a 30-minute phone consult about your kitchen, bath, basement or addition, or send the project form and the Sweeney team will follow up.

hero.h1: Kitchen and Bath Remodeling in Mequon, Designed and Built by Wade
hero.subheadline: Michael Wade's team listens first, then designs and builds your kitchen or bath under one roof. Over 25 years remodeling homes from Cedarburg to Whitefish Bay.

image.alt: Kitchen and bath remodeling Mequon: Bonniwell kitchen with coffered wood ceiling, arched doorway, dark island and glass pendant light

intro.h2: A Mequon remodeler that starts by asking how you live
paragraphs: Wade Design & Construction handles kitchen and bath remodeling in Mequon and across the North Shore from its office on West Mequon Road. Every project begins with a conversation about your routines: what is not working, where storage runs short, how light moves through the room. The plan grows from those answers, not from a trend board.

Designers and project managers work on one team, so you never pass messages between separate companies. The same group handles whole-home remodels, additions, basements and one-off ideas like wine rooms and screened porches. Clients on Google describe the work as exceptional and say the team really listened during planning.

services.h2: Kitchen and bath remodeling in Mequon, plus whole homes and more

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Layouts that cut wasted steps and ease traffic, custom cabinetry built around how you cook, layered lighting and integrated storage. The team looks closely at cabinet depth and workflow so the finished kitchen works for hosting, homework and quiet mornings alike.

image.alt: Mohawk Road kitchen remodel with walnut island seating, white upper cabinets, open wood shelves and a professional range

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary baths, powder rooms and dated hall baths with custom vanities, spa-style showers with set niches, heated floors and quiet ventilation. Zero-threshold entries and universal design details are part of the menu for families planning to stay in their homes.

image.alt: Holly Road bathroom remodel with green glazed wall tile, freestanding tub, brass floor-mounted tub filler and hexagon floor tile

items.name: Whole-Home Remodeling
items.blurb: A chance to start fresh without moving. Wade rethinks layout and flow, updates systems and picks finishes that hold up to daily life, whether that means opening walls, moving key rooms or tying a dated first floor together.

image.alt: Americana whole-home remodel with open dining room, cluster pendant lighting and a fieldstone fireplace in the family room

items.name: Basement Remodeling
items.blurb: Media rooms, guest suites with full baths, wet bars and home gyms. Moisture control, insulation, soundproofing and airflow are planned first, so the finished lower level feels warm and dry instead of dark and cold.

image.alt: Finished basement on Riveredge Court with leather sectional, blue paneled wall, built-in shelving and patterned carpet

items.name: Specialty Projects and Additions
items.blurb: The ideas that do not fit a category: wine rooms with custom racking and climate control, screened porches with true indoor-outdoor flow, front porch additions, built-in nooks and room additions over garages. Structural and technical challenges are welcome here.

image.alt: Custom wine cellar with arched ceiling, wood wine racking, lighted display cabinets and glass-paned doors

why_choose_us.h2: What sets Wade apart on the North Shore

items.title: Award-winning bath design
items.text: Wade earned a 2025 Chrysalis Award in the $50,000 to $75,000 bath remodel class for a 1925 guest bath with an arched shower entry and traditional fixtures.

items.title: Years of Houzz service honors
items.text: Best of Houzz for Service in 2013 through 2016, 2018 and 2020 through 2025, plus Best of Houzz for Design in five separate years.

items.title: One team, start to finish
items.text: Designers and project managers stay in sync from the first meeting to final trim, so you have one point of contact instead of a string of separate contractors.

items.title: Schedules clients can plan around
items.text: One client wrote that their first-floor remodel was quoted at about six weeks and finished on time, with daily cleanup and a heads-up whenever crews planned to arrive before 8 a.m.

about.h2: Meet Michael Wade and the team behind the work
about.text: Michael Wade is President of Wade Design & Construction, a full-service design-build firm based in Mequon. Clients often mention Mike by name: one reviewer said he had great ideas for keeping the charm of a 1950s bathroom, and another credits him with designing both her kitchen and primary bath. He works alongside a close-knit group of designers, project managers and trusted local craftspeople. The firm stays rooted in town, too, sponsoring LionFest, the Fox Point Farmers' Market and the Mequon Thiensville Turkey Trot. It belongs to NKBA, the Metro Builders Association and the Mequon-Thiensville Chamber.

image.alt: Michael Wade, President of Wade Design & Construction in Mequon, WI

process.h2: Six steps on their site, five stages for you

steps.title: Getting to know each other
steps.text: A first meeting about how your household moves through the space, what frustrates you and what you picture for the finished room.

steps.title: Designing together
steps.text: The design team shapes a plan around your goals and style, walking through options with you before anything is final.

steps.title: Agreements and selections
steps.text: Once agreements are signed, the team guides you through tile, cabinetry, fixtures and finishes so choices are ready before crews need them.

steps.title: Building your project
steps.text: Project managers coordinate the crew and trusted local trades, keep you updated and protect the parts of your home still in use.

steps.title: Peace of mind and warranty
steps.text: The process closes with a warranty handoff, and the team stays available to support you and your home after the dust settles.

items.text: Wade Construction did an amazing job remodeling a master bathroom and hall bathroom for us. We were impressed with their attention to detail, communication and design advice. The bathrooms not only met our criteria and expectations, but far exceeded them.

service_area.h2: Serving Mequon and the Milwaukee North Shore
service_area.text: Wade's office sits on West Mequon Road, and most projects land within a short drive of it. The team remodels kitchens, baths and whole homes in Mequon, Thiensville and Cedarburg in Ozaukee County, and in Bayside, Fox Point, River Hills, Whitefish Bay and Milwaukee to the south. Projects elsewhere in Southeast Wisconsin are welcome too, so call to ask about your street.

faq.h2: Questions North Shore homeowners ask Wade

items.q: Do you design and build, or do I need a separate designer?
items.a: Both happen under one roof. Wade is a full-service design-build firm, so the designers who draw your plan work beside the project managers who build it. You avoid juggling multiple contractors, and details you care about carry through from the first sketch to the final trim.

items.q: Can you update an older home without losing its character?
items.a: Yes. Wade's 2025 Chrysalis Award came from a 1925 guest bath that kept traditional fixtures and added an arched shower entry. Another client wrote that Mike had great ideas for keeping some of the charm of her 1950s bathroom while making it work today.

items.q: How long does a remodel take?
items.a: It depends on scope, and the team sets the schedule during planning. As one example, a client wrote that their first-floor remodel was quoted at about six weeks and was finished in about six weeks. Having your own selections ready on time helps the schedule hold.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty?
items.a: Yes. The final step of Wade's six-step process is called Peace of mind and warranty, and the team says it stays available to support you after the project wraps up. Ask during your consultation for the written warranty terms that apply to your project.

items.q: How do I get started?
items.a: Call (262) 512-1799 or fill in the short contact form with your location and a description of the project. The first meeting is a conversation about how you live and what you want from the space, so bring photos, wish lists and frustrations.

final_cta.h2: Tell Mike's team what is not working at home
final_cta.text: Share your kitchen or bath plans and the Wade team will set up a design conversation in Mequon or at your house.

intro.h2: A Chicago bathroom crew that knows condo boards and old plumbing
paragraphs: Wood Contracting handles bathroom remodeling in Chicago for high-rise condos, townhomes and vintage single-family homes. Owner Dillon Wood oversees every job himself, and his own in-house tradespeople do the work instead of rotating subcontractors. services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Chicago, plus kitchens and carpentry

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling

items.name: Condo Remodeling

items.name: Basement Finishing

why_choose_us.h2: What sets this crew apart on Chicago jobs

items.title: Dillon is on every job

items.title: Itemized, plain pricing

service_area.h2: Chicago neighborhoods where Dillon's crew works
service_area.text: Most projects are in downtown and North Side neighborhoods, from South Loop lofts and Printer's Row conversions to Lincoln Park greystones and Old Town cottages. The firm's service area runs across Cook County from Hyde Park to Evanston. Each building type has its own approval rules and plumbing quirks, and the crew plans for them before the first wall opens. If your home is outside this list, call and ask.

faq.h2: Questions Chicago homeowners ask Wood Contracting

items.q: How many weeks will my Chicago bathroom be torn up?
items.a: Most bathrooms take 2 to 5 weeks from demolition to completion, and kitchens usually take 4 to 6 weeks. City permits, when needed, add roughly 2 to 4 weeks of review before work starts. You get a detailed timeline at the free consultation, and the crew works to hold it.

items.q: What price range should I plan for?
items.a: The site lists bathroom remodels from about $12,000 to $55,000+, depending on size and finishes. A powder room update sits at the low end and a primary bath with custom features at the high end. Kitchens generally run $15,000 to $80,000+. Your proposal is itemized so you see where the money goes.

items.q: Will my condo board and building rules slow things down?
items.a: Not usually. Condo work is a large share of the business. The team handles HOA submissions, building coordination, elevator reservations and work-hour rules, and uses waterproofing that protects the units below. One reviewer chose the firm partly because Dillon already knew their building.

items.q: Can I stay home during the remodel?
items.a: Most clients do. The crew contains dust, protects the rest of your home and cleans up every day. Some disruption is unavoidable, especially during a kitchen remodel, but the team plans the work to keep it as small as possible.

items.q: What if you find damage behind the walls?
items.a: Older Chicago buildings can hide water damage, outdated wiring or structural problems. If something turns up during demolition, the team stops to explain your options, prices the repair clearly and moves forward only once you agree. There are no hidden fees added at the end.

final_cta.h2: Talk to Dillon about your bathroom
final_cta.text: Call (312) 405-5837 to book a free site visit and estimate, or use the contact form to describe your bathroom and a time that suits you.

hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Roseville, Priced Line by Line
hero.subheadline: Anani Remodeling is a licensed Roseville crew that plans your kitchen around how you cook, builds the cabinetry to fit, and hands you a written quote before any work starts.

intro.h2: Kitchen Remodeling in Roseville, with the Numbers Up Front
paragraphs: Most people asking about kitchen remodeling in Roseville want two things before anyone swings a hammer: a real price and a real schedule. Anani Remodeling gives you both. After an in-home visit, you get a written quote that lists materials, trades and phases line by line, and if anything changes mid-project, you hear about it before the crew acts.

The office is on Lava Ridge Court, so site visits, sample reviews and inspection days are run by people who work locally, not a franchise crew sent from hours away. Some clients gut the whole room. Others only need the layout fixed or the cabinets swapped. Both get the same care, and Natalie K. noted the crew showed up on time every day.

services.h2: Kitchens, Baths and Cabinets Built to Fit

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full remodels that rethink layout, plumbing, electrical, cabinets, counters and lighting, or targeted upgrades like new counters, refacing and better light. If a wall needs to come out, the team checks what is structural, brings in an engineer when needed and prices the change.

image.alt: White kitchen remodel with waterfall quartz island, woven counter stools, open oak shelves and a plaster range hood

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Guest bath refreshes and full primary suite overhauls: walk-in shower conversions, frameless glass, custom tile, new vanities, heated floors and freestanding tubs. Every bath starts with a real in-home consultation, not a ballpark over the phone, and permits are handled for you.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with frameless glass walk-in shower, large light stone tile and a warm wood vanity with black pulls

items.name: Custom Cabinetry
items.blurb: Cabinets built to the exact size of your room, with no filler strips or wasted corners. Choose the wood, finish and hardware, with dovetail joinery and soft-close drawers. The same crew that builds them installs them, for kitchens, vanities, closets, offices and built-ins.

image.alt: Custom walnut kitchen island with fluted panels and turned legs beside sage green perimeter cabinets and an arched open shelf niche

why_choose_us.h2: What Homeowners Get from Anani Remodeling

items.title: Planning prices in public
items.text: The site lists typical ranges for the Roseville and Sacramento market, from $25,000 for a cosmetic refresh to $100,000 and up for a high-end renovation. Your own number comes in writing after a visit.

items.title: One crew from shop to install
items.text: Custom cabinets are made to order and installed by the same crew that built them. No outsourcing and no dropped details between the shop and your kitchen.

items.title: Permits planned by city
items.text: Roseville, Rocklin, Folsom and Sacramento each run their own building review, while Granite Bay, Fair Oaks and El Dorado Hills go through the county. The team plans the schedule around the office that covers your address.

items.title: Finished ahead of schedule
items.text: Reviewers mention upfront pricing with no hidden costs, a crew that arrived on time daily, and the easiest estimate process of all the companies one homeowner called.

about.h2: Founded by Daniel Malinovskiy, Run from Roseville
about.text: Daniel Malinovskiy founded Anani Remodeling as a Sacramento-area contractor, not a franchise. The company focuses on kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling and custom cabinetry, and manages each job from design through construction. Homeowners work directly with the principals rather than a salesperson or call center, and one point of contact stays with the project from the first call to the final walkthrough. The team counts more than 150 delivered projects and over 10 years of combined experience. Most new clients come from a neighbor's recommendation, and the company is licensed, bonded and insured under CSLB #1157715.

service_area.h2: Placer, Sacramento and El Dorado County Towns We Serve
service_area.text: The team works out of Roseville and takes kitchens and baths across Rocklin, Granite Bay, Folsom, El Dorado Hills, Fair Oaks and Sacramento. That covers newer planned-community homes with builder-grade kitchens as well as older Land Park and East Sacramento bungalows where wiring and drain lines need a closer look. faq.h2: Kitchen and Bath Questions from Roseville Homeowners

items.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Roseville?
items.a: Anani publishes planning ranges for the Roseville and Sacramento market: about $25,000 to $45,000 for a cosmetic refresh, $50,000 to $90,000 for a mid-range full remodel, and $100,000 and up for a high-end renovation. These are starting points only. Your price comes in writing, line by line, after the team sees your kitchen.

items.q: How long will my kitchen be out of service?
items.a: From first meeting to cooking again, a full remodel often takes about three to five months, because design, permits and cabinet orders come first. The kitchen itself is usually out of use for four to eight weeks. The team flags the most disruptive days ahead of time so you can set up a temporary station.

items.q: Do you pull permits in Roseville and the other towns?
items.a: Yes. The team prepares permit applications, submits plans and schedules inspections on every project that needs them. Roseville, Rocklin, Folsom and Sacramento use their own city building offices, while Granite Bay, Fair Oaks and El Dorado Hills go through their counties, so the schedule is planned around your office.

items.q: Is financing available?
items.a: Yes. Financing options are available through Foundation Finance, subject to lender approval and terms. You can also phase a project if you would rather spread the work out. Ask about both during your free in-home estimate so your written quote can reflect the plan that fits your budget.

items.q: Is the work covered by a warranty?
items.a: The site describes a 1-Year Artisan Warranty: completed work is backed by a warranty covering labor and installation, plus the manufacturer warranties on materials. Ask for the written warranty terms with your quote so you know exactly what is covered on your kitchen or bathroom project.

intro.h2: A founder you can reach, and the photos to back it up
paragraphs: Better Remodels handles kitchen remodeling in Orange County from its office on East Emerson Avenue in Orange. Founder Don Garcia stays close to each job, and his name comes up in review after review. Clients say he is clear about timeline and cost from the first visit.

The project gallery holds 40 finished jobs, each labeled by town, from a Garden Grove kitchen to a Huntington Beach bath. Most include before and after photos, so you can judge the work before you call. Kitchens and bathrooms are the core of the business, with full-home remodels, house extensions and ADUs for bigger plans.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Orange County, plus baths and full remodels

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full redesigns that can move walls and update plumbing and electrical, plus custom cabinets with appliance garages and pantry storage. Counters come in granite, quartz, marble or concrete. Most full kitchen remodels take 6 to 10 weeks from demolition to the final punch list.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with white cabinets, a navy blue island, white range hood and brick-look backsplash

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Complete gut renovations with new layouts, plumbing and electrical, or focused updates. Options include walk-in showers, wet rooms, freestanding tubs, frameless glass and custom vanities with linen storage. A standard bathroom takes 3 to 5 weeks, and a large primary bath with moved plumbing can take 5 to 7.

image.alt: Bathroom remodel with a floating wood vanity, two white sinks and tall backlit mirrors

items.name: Walk-In Baths and Accessible Bathrooms
items.blurb: Walk-in tubs with inward-swinging doors, deep soaking basins and optional air or hydrotherapy jets, sized to fit standard bathtub cutouts. Accessible bath plans can add grab bars, non-slip floors and ADA-compliant layouts. Most walk-in tub installs take 1 to 5 days.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with white square floor tile, a center drain and a teak shower bench

items.name: Full Home Remodeling
items.blurb: Whole-house projects that open up floor plans, rework walls and update electrical, plumbing and HVAC. Work starts with a structural check, 3D design and permits, then moves to cabinets, flooring and lighting. A full home remodel typically runs 4 to 8 months.

image.alt: Santa Ana home remodel kitchen with pale sage upper cabinets, navy lower cabinets, a farmhouse sink and white counters

why_choose_us.h2: Why homeowners from Irvine to La Habra call Better Remodels

about.h2: Meet Don Garcia, founder of Better Remodels
about.text: Donald Garcia, MBA, is the CEO and founder of Better Remodels, a company founded in Orange County that has been remodeling local homes for over a decade. Clients simply call him Don. The company answers its Google reviews, and one reply sums up the goal: 'No drama' might be the favorite part of a review, because 'That's always the goal.' faq.h2: Questions Orange County homeowners ask

items.q: How long does a kitchen remodel take in Orange County?
items.a: Most full kitchen remodels take 6 to 10 weeks from demolition to the final punch list. The range depends on structural changes and the lead time for custom cabinets. You get a phase-by-phase timeline at your free consultation, so you know how long the kitchen will be out of use.

items.q: What does the free consultation include?
items.a: It is an in-home visit with no obligation. You get design ideas, a professional 3D visualization, material recommendations, a project timeline and a detailed written estimate with no hidden costs. Call or fill out the form, and the team gets back to you within 24 hours.

items.q: Is Better Remodels licensed and insured?
items.a: Yes. The company states that it is fully licensed, bonded and insured in California. Ask for the license number at your consultation and look it up with the Contractors State License Board before you sign, as you would with any contractor.

items.q: Can you install a walk-in tub for an older parent?
items.a: Yes. Better Remodels installs walk-in baths with inward-swinging doors, deep soaking basins and optional hydrotherapy jets, sized to fit standard bathtub cutouts. Most installs take 1 to 5 days. An accessible bathroom plan can also add grab bars, non-slip flooring and an ADA-compliant layout.

items.q: Is there a reward for referring a friend?
items.a: Yes, for full-home remodels. When someone you refer signs a qualifying full-home remodeling agreement, you each get $500 off a qualifying full-home remodel. It does not apply to single rooms or repairs unless Better Remodels confirms otherwise, and your friend should mention your name when they first call.

intro.h2: A remodeler that settles the plan first
paragraphs: Five Fold Solutions handles bathroom remodeling in Overland Park and across Johnson County from its office on Lamar Avenue. The team's view is simple: most remodel problems start before demo day, with unclear scope, rushed selections and poor communication. So the scope, budget and schedule are agreed first, and the build comes second.

Every job opens with a 10 to 15 minute phone call, then an on-site walkthrough if the project looks like a fit. You get updates on a set schedule, changes in writing and a structured final walkthrough. Since launching in March 2024, the company has completed more than 120 projects.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Overland Park, plus kitchens and outdoor rooms

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Primary, guest and hall baths, with layout changes, walk-in showers and tub-to-shower conversions when they make sense. Five Fold coordinates plumbing, lighting, ventilation, custom tile, shower niches, vanities and storage, then closes out with a walkthrough of the finished room.

items.name: Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Space planning, cabinet replacement, countertops, backsplash, lighting and electrical updates, with structural changes when the layout needs them. image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with honey maple cabinets, stainless appliances and a white quartz peninsula by Five Fold Solutions

items.name: Whole-Home Renovations and Additions
items.blurb: When a project goes past one room, Five Fold plans the full scope under one contract and one team. That can mean kitchen and bath work together, basement finishing, home additions, new flooring and lighting, or layout changes that improve how people move through the house.

image.alt: 1960s ranch after a whole-home renovation with a new gabled porch, cedar posts, stone columns and blue board-and-batten siding

items.name: Decks and Outdoor Living
items.blurb: Cedar and composite decks, screened porches, covered patios and pergolas planned for Kansas City weather. One Overland Park backyard went from an old gazebo to a new pool walkway, deck and pavilion in 10 weeks, with stone-wrapped columns and an Azek tongue-and-groove ceiling.

items.title: Scope before tools
items.text: Scope, pricing and expectations are written down before work begins. The Olathe kitchen refresh on the company's case study page finished in 6 weeks and lists 0 surprises.

service_area.h2: Johnson County towns on our schedule
service_area.text: Five Fold works out of 6310 Lamar Ave in Overland Park and takes projects across Johnson County and the Kansas City metro. Bathroom clients come from Overland Park, Leawood, Prairie Village, Mission Hills, Fairway, Lenexa, Shawnee and Olathe, and the footer of the site adds Louisburg, Edgerton and Bonner Springs. Not sure your street is covered? Put the project address in your message and the team will confirm on the first call.

faq.h2: Overland Park bathroom remodel questions

items.q: How do I start a bathroom remodel with Five Fold?
items.a: Call (913) 904-6400 or send the contact form with a short note about the room. The first step is a 10 to 15 minute phone call about your goals, timing and general scope. If the project looks like a good fit, the next step is an on-site walkthrough of the bathroom.

items.q: Is the first consultation free?
items.a: Yes. Five Fold's Google Business Profile invites homeowners to schedule a free consultation, and its outdoor living pages offer a complimentary site walk-through. Pricing for the remodel itself comes later, once the scope, layout and selections are defined, so the number you sign reflects the work that was actually agreed.

items.q: Can you turn my tub into a walk-in shower?
items.a: Often, yes. Tub-to-shower conversions are on the bathroom scope list when they suit the room, along with walk-in showers, layout changes, custom tile, shower niches and new vanities. The team looks at plumbing, ventilation and the existing conditions during the walkthrough before recommending it.

items.q: What drives the cost of a bathroom remodel?
items.a: Five Fold names six drivers: room size and access, layout changes and plumbing moves, the shower system and its glass and tile, storage and vanity details, lighting and ventilation needs, and the finish level of fixtures, tile and flooring. Instead of quoting a range up front, the team prices the scope once the room is understood.

items.q: Are you licensed and insured, and who handles permits?
items.a: Five Fold Solutions is a licensed contractor, fully insured and a BBB Accredited Business. Permit and trade coordination is part of the project management the team provides, along with sequencing, quality review and final detailing, so you are not left calling the city or chasing subcontractors yourself.

final_cta.h2: Talk through your bathroom in 15 minutes
final_cta.text: Call Max and Jason's team at (913) 904-6400 for a short first conversation, or send your project details and the address and they will set up the next step.

seo.title_tag: Kitchen Remodeling in Cleveland, OH | Keselman Construction
seo.meta_description: Award-winning kitchen remodeling in Cleveland since 2004, plus baths and basements. 4.9 stars on 220 Google reviews. Call (216) 208-6365 for a free consult.
seo.og_title: Keselman Construction Group: kitchens and baths across Greater Cleveland
seo.og_description: Eight first-place 2025 Cleveland Choice Awards, more than 3,000 projects since 2004 and a showroom in Solon. See recent kitchens, baths and basements.

hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Cleveland From an Award-Winning Local Team
hero.subheadline: Keselman Construction Group has finished more than 3,000 projects across Northeast Ohio since 2004. Design, estimating and building all stay with one in-house team.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Cleveland area project in Solon, OH: sage green shaker cabinets, wood ceiling beam, white oak open shelves and a wide island with a pendant light

intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Cleveland, backed by 22 years of work
paragraphs: Keselman Construction Group has offered kitchen remodeling in Cleveland and its suburbs since 2004. Designers, estimators, project managers and craftsmen all work in-house, out of a showroom in Solon. More than 3,000 finished projects later, about 80% of new work still comes from referrals.

The crew's recent work shows the range. A Solon range wall with a hood that matches the lower cabinets. A Pepper Pike basement with a backlit media wall and a wet bar. Two bold Solon baths, one with a crane print and a coral vanity. Reviewers name their project managers, Ivan and Sergiy, and say the crews were efficient and kept them informed.

services.h2: What the Keselman team designs and builds

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Your designer starts with a floor plan and 3D renderings, then the estimating team prices the cabinets, counters and labor line by line. Recent kitchens in Solon, Beachwood, Lakewood and Eastlake mix painted shaker cabinets, white oak and big islands with seating.

image.alt: Solon, OH kitchen remodel with sage green cabinets, white quartz island, glass pendant lights and a stainless range

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: From quiet hall baths to statement rooms. One Solon project paired palm wallpaper with a leopard tile floor, and its neighbor got a crane print, a coral vanity and teal trim. Spa-style primary baths with glass showers and double vanities are just as common.

image.alt: Solon, OH powder bath remodel with crane-print wallpaper, coral vanity with open shelves, oval lighted mirror and brass faucet

items.name: Basement Remodels
items.blurb: Basements are designed in renderings before anyone swings a hammer. Home gyms, saunas, wet bars, guest rooms and media walls are all on the list. The Pepper Pike basement finished in October 2026 added a lounge, a backlit TV wall and a full bath.

image.alt: Pepper Pike, OH basement remodel with dark media wall, backlit TV, lighted oak shelving and sectional sofa

items.name: Whole-Home Remodels and Additions
items.blurb: For homeowners ready to change more than one room, the same in-house team handles full remodels, home additions and custom new homes. The Eastlake remodel posted in October 2026 opened the kitchen to the dining room and updated the baths.

image.alt: Eastlake, OH home remodel with open kitchen, navy island, hardwood floors and dining area by the windows

items.name: Fire and Water Damage Reconstruction
items.blurb: After a fire, water or sewage loss, Keselman moves from clean-up to a full rebuild, often finishing with a remodeled room. Past jobs include a Shaker Heights reconstruction, a Mayfield Heights fire restoration and a Lyndhurst kitchen rebuilt after a house fire.

image.alt: Lyndhurst, OH kitchen rebuilt by Keselman Construction Group after a house fire

why_choose_us.h2: Reasons Cleveland homeowners pick Keselman

items.title: Judged best by local builders
items.text: At the 2025 Cleveland Choice Awards from HBA Greater Cleveland, Keselman took eight first places, including Kitchen Renovation Under $100,000 and both bathroom renovation classes.

items.title: Estimates you can read
items.text: Once drawings are final, suppliers price the materials and the estimating team writes a detailed proposal with labor scope and finish allowances. It usually takes two weeks or less.

items.title: One project manager, live updates
items.text: Each job gets its own project manager and a timeline in project management software that you can follow. Google reviewers single out how their project managers kept them informed.

items.title: Financing through Regions Bank
items.text: Pre-qualify online with a soft credit pull. Plans include 9-month same-as-cash and an 11.99% APR loan of up to 12 years, on approved credit. FHA 203k help is offered too.

about.h2: The people behind Keselman Construction Group
about.text: Keselman Construction Group is led by Zakhar Keselman, partner and CEO, who also holds certifications through the Institute of Inspection Cleaning and Restoration. That training sits behind the firm's fire and water rebuild work. The design side is staffed by NARI Certified Remodeling Designers, including Diana Dyachuk and Jordan Suglio. An Estimate Consultant meets you first, at your home or at the Solon showroom. A dedicated project manager then runs the build. The company says it is not a national franchise or a sales-driven operation, but a local team of craftsmen.

process.h2: Six steps on the site, five stages for you

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: The Estimate Consultant meets you at home or at the Solon office, talks through goals and budget, and gives an approximate estimate when possible.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: The staff designer listens first, then draws a floor plan and 3D renderings. You review and revise them before anything is final.

steps.title: Pricing and planning
steps.text: Suppliers price the drawings, and you get a detailed proposal by email, a review meeting, then a contract and draw schedule.

steps.title: Pre-production
steps.text: You pick finishes so orders go in on time. Your project manager and estimator walk the site with you and set the shared timeline.

steps.title: Build and punch list
steps.text: Work starts once materials and permits are in. A final walk-through creates a punch list, the touch-up crew closes it, and your warranty begins.

service_area.h2: From Solon to Lakewood: towns we remodel in
service_area.text: Keselman works from a showroom on Davis Industrial Parkway in Solon, open by appointment, and remodels homes across Greater Cleveland. The east side is close to home, with recent jobs in Solon, Pepper Pike, Beachwood and Eastlake. West-side work reaches Lakewood, Rocky River and Avon Lake, and the south runs to Broadview Heights and Richfield. If your town is not listed, call and ask.

faq.h2: Before you call: common questions

items.q: Is the first consultation free?
items.a: Yes. Keselman offers a free remodeling consultation. The Estimate Consultant meets you at your home or at the Solon office. You talk through why you are remodeling, set a budget you can stick to, and look at what your home could become. When possible, you also get an approximate estimate based on your ideas.

items.q: How long does it take to get a full estimate?
items.a: Once your design or blueprint is done, the drawings go to suppliers for material pricing while the estimating team writes the labor scope and finish allowances. The process typically takes two weeks or less. The estimate arrives by email, followed by a meeting to review it and make changes before a contract is drawn up.

items.q: Can I finance a kitchen or bath remodel?
items.a: Yes, through Regions Bank on approved credit. Options listed on the site include a 9-month same-as-cash loan, a traditional installment loan from 8.99% to 24.49% APR, and an 11.99% APR loan of up to 12 years. You can pre-qualify online with a soft credit pull. FHA 203k and HomeStyle loan help is also offered.

items.q: Can I visit your showroom in Solon?
items.a: Yes, by appointment. The showroom is at 6500 Davis Industrial Pkwy, Solon, OH 44139, and the office keeps hours Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm. Call (216) 208-6365 to set a time. Many clients pick finishes there with the staff designer during the pre-production stage.

items.q: Are you insured, and what happens at the end of a job?
items.a: The company states it is insured and bonded with each city it works in. Near the end of construction, your project manager walks the home with you and writes a punch list. The touch-up crew then finishes every item on it, and your warranty begins once that list is closed out.

final_cta.h2: Start with a free consultation in Solon or at home
final_cta.text: Call the Keselman team Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm, or send the form and an Estimate Consultant will set up your first meeting.

service_area.h2: Serving Poway and San Diego County
